messages:
Maya Chen: Quick thought: switch 'Stop' to 'Pin draft' for streaming replies so partial output becomes a pinned draft you can edit later. Thoughts?
Devin Patel: 'Pin draft' reads much friendlier. Keyboard mapping? Esc to toggle live/pause; P to pin when focus is on the stream. Regenerate should create a new reply, unless user explicitly 'Replace draft'.
Sasha Rivera: Microcopy: prefer 'Pin draft', 'Replace draft', 'Resume live'. Tooltips should explain 'Pin creates a read-only draft; use Edit to modify.' Also ensure toast copy: 'Draft pinned — Undo'.
Alan Ng: Token UX: experiment with a session-level compact meter in the composer (small badge + thin progress bar) and a per-message token badge only shown on hover or when pinned. That reduces visual clutter.
Jyoti Rao: A11y: session meter must have role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, and token badges must be keyboard-focusable with aria-label like 'Message tokens: 52'. Avoid live-region spam during streaming; announce pinned/updated via polite aria-live once.
Devin Patel: Implementation notes: debounce pin action 300ms; show a quick shimmer skeleton when pinning long streams. Prompt-shelf filter debounce 150ms. After inserting prompt, keep focus in composer; show undo toast but do not steal focus.
Playground Bot: TokenWatch: session tokens 1,042 (+52 pending). Est cost $0.0053.
Maya Chen: Action items: Alan prototype session meter + hover badge; Devin wire P/Esc keybindings + debounce; Jyoti write accessibility checklist; Sasha finalize microcopy. I'll update figma with a small spec. :sparkles:
